name: Helm Chart CI/CD

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - "helm/**"
      - ".github/workflows/helm-chart.yml"
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - "v*"

jobs:
  lint-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683

      - name: Set up Helm
        uses: azure/setup-helm@fe7b79cd5ee1e45176fcad797de68ecaf3ca4814

      - name: Lint Chart
        run: |
          helm lint helm/falkordb-browser

      - name: Template Chart
        run: |
          helm template falkordb-browser helm/falkordb-browser

      - name: Run Chart Tests
        run: |
          helm dependency build helm/falkordb-browser
          helm test falkordb-browser --namespace default

  kind-integration-test:
    needs: lint-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        k8s-version: ["1.28.x"]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683

      - name: Setup Kind
        uses: helm/kind-action@0025e74a8c7512023d06dc019c617aa3cf561fde
        with:
          version: v0.24.0
          kubectl_version: v1.28.0
          cluster_name: kind

      - name: Install Helm
        uses: azure/setup-helm@fe7b79cd5ee1e45176fcad797de68ecaf3ca4814

      - name: Deploy Chart to Kind
        run: |
          helm install falkordb-browser helm/falkordb-browser \
            --namespace default \
            --create-namespace \
            --set image.tag=latest

      - name: Verify Deployment
        run: |
          kubectl wait --for=condition=ready pod -l app.kubernetes.io/name=falkordb-browser --timeout=300s

  publish:
    needs: kind-integration-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Helm Charts Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          repository: FalkorDB/helm-charts
          token: ${{ secrets.GHCR_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          path: helm-charts

      - name: Set up Helm
        uses: azure/setup-helm@fe7b79cd5ee1e45176fcad797de68ecaf3ca4814

      - name: Install yq
        run: |
          curl -L https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/download/v4.40.5/yq_linux_amd64.tar.gz | tar xz
          sudo mv yq /usr/local/bin/
          echo "yq version: $(yq --version)"

      - name: Package Chart
        run: |
          helm package helm/falkordb-browser -d helm-charts/charts

      - name: Update Index
        run: |
          cd helm-charts
          helm repo index . --url https://falkordb.github.io/helm-charts --merge ./index.yaml

      - name: Commit and Push Changes
        run: |
          cd helm-charts
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          git commit -m "Update Helm chart falkordb-browser to version ${{ github.ref_name }}" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin main
